details: The U.S. government has moved approximately 3,800 BTC ($235 million) and 30,000 ETH ($53 million) from various criminal cases to Coinbase Prime. This action has revived speculation among investors about potential government sales of these substantial crypto holdings.
title: US Government Transfers $288M in Seized BTC and ETH to Coinbase Prime

details: The privacy team from the Ethereum Foundation has spun out to form EthSystems, a new for-profit entity. Backed by Ethereum co-founder Joe Lubin and Bitmine, the new company aims to develop confidential systems tailored for institutional users within the Ethereum ecosystem.
title: Ethereum Foundation Privacy Team Spins Out as For-Profit EthSystems

details: Wall Street analysts are reportedly growing cautious regarding Circle, the issuer of the USDC stablecoin. Mizuho has downgraded Circle's stock, and JPMorgan has lowered earnings estimates, citing increasing competition from new stablecoins like Open USD and redemptions that are outpacing new USDC issuance.
title: Wall Street Cautious on Circle as USDC Economics Face Pressure

details: A joint transatlantic taskforce between the United States and the United Kingdom has released a digital asset roadmap. The initiative seeks to deepen cooperation and foster innovation in stablecoins and tokenized assets, with a focus on ensuring clear legal claims on reserves and facilitating cross-border capital raising.
title: US-UK Taskforce Unveils Digital Asset Roadmap for Stablecoin Innovation

details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has directed the prediction market platform Kalshi to uphold trades made by Michigan residents. This order comes despite a conflicting state court directive to cancel such contracts, as the CFTC asserts its jurisdiction to prevent broader market disruption.
title: CFTC Orders Kalshi to Honor Michigan Trades Amid Regulatory Clash

details: The U.S. Senate has approximately 20 working days to advance the CLARITY Act before its August 7 recess. Investor Kevin O'Leary estimates a 50/50 chance of passage, with a revised draft expected. The legislation could provide regulatory clarity for digital assets, potentially unlocking significant institutional capital.
title: CLARITY Act Enters Critical Senate Window Before August Recess

details: Bitcoin experienced a rebound, climbing above $63,000, following the release of June's U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) data. The inflation figure came in lower than expected at 3.5%, which has eased market concerns about aggressive interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve and contributed to broader gains across crypto markets.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds as US CPI Falls to 3.5%, Below Expectations
